prompt.label: Easy — Sales Reporting Confusion (NON-AI, CRUD/dashboard)
prompt.userMessage: Our regional sales managers are all bringing different numbers into the weekly executive meeting, and we spend more time debating which spreadsheet is correct than discussing the business itself. Finance, Sales, and Operations all seem to define 'active customer' differently, which is creating tension between teams. Leadership wants one trusted view of pipeline performance and renewals without forcing people to manually reconcile reports every Friday. We need a way to make reporting more consistent and easier to trust across departments.

rounds.content:
{
  "action": "clarify",
  "round": 1,
  "message": "Before we lock this in, it could go a few directions — which is closest to what you want?

A) Unified KPI dashboard — pulls pipeline + renewal numbers from Snowflake using one shared definition of 'active customer', so everyone sees the same chart (no AI)
B) Definition governance tool — workflow where Finance/Sales/Ops propose and approve shared metric definitions, with version history and sign-off (no AI)
C) AI-powered metrics Q&A — execs ask 'how many active customers in EMEA last quarter?' in plain English and get a cited answer from your warehouse + policy docs (AI in the loop)
D) Weekly report builder — managers assemble their Friday report from pre-built, pre-reconciled components; tool tracks who submitted what (no AI)"
}

          {"name": "error", "type": "TEXT"}

      {"method": "GET", "path": "/dashboard/renewals", "request": "?range=30d", "response": {"status": 200, "body": "{ kpis: [...], series: [...], definitions_used: [...] }"}},
      {"method": "GET", "path": "/charts/:chartKey/export", "response": {"status": 200, "body": "text/csv stream"}},
      {"method": "GET", "path": "/metric-definitions", "response": {"status": 200, "body": "{ items: [{id, metric_key, display_name, description, category, sql_template, parameters, updated_by, updated_at}] }"}},
      {"method": "GET", "path": "/metric-definitions/:id", "response": {"status": 200, "body": "{ id, metric_key, display_name, description, category, sql_template, parameters, updated_by, updated_at }"}},
      {"method": "POST", "path": "/metric-definitions", "request": "{ metric_key, display_name, description, category, sql_template, parameters }", "response": {"status": 201, "body": "{ id, metric_key }"}},
      {"method": "PUT", "path": "/metric-definitions/:id", "request": "{ display_name, description, sql_template, parameters, change_note }", "response": {"status": 200, "body": "{ id, metric_key, updated_at }"}},
      {"method": "GET", "path": "/metric-definitions/:id/history", "response": {"status": 200, "body": "{ items: [{id, previous_value, new_value, change_note, changed_by_email, changed_at}] }"}},

    ]

    "primary_view": "executive dashboard of pipeline and renewals KPIs",
    "primary_action": "view the current trusted numbers for the week",
    "secondary_views": [
      "pipeline performance detail",
      "renewals detail",
      "admin metric definitions list",
      "metric definition editor with audit history",
      "weekly snapshot preview"
    ],
    "components": [
      {"name": "DashboardHome", "role": "top-level KPI grid plus pipeline and renewals chart cards"},
      {"name": "KpiCard", "role": "single KPI tile with value, delta, and the metric definition it used"},
      {"name": "ChartCard", "role": "chart container with title, range selector, and Export CSV button"},
      {"name": "PipelineView", "role": "detailed pipeline performance charts"},
      {"name": "RenewalsView", "role": "detailed renewals charts"},
      {"name": "DefinitionsUsedBadge", "role": "inline indicator showing which metric_definitions powered a chart"},
      {"name": "AdminMetricDefinitionsList", "role": "admin table of all metric definitions"},
      {"name": "MetricDefinitionEditor", "role": "form to edit a definition with diff preview and change note"},
      {"name": "MetricDefinitionHistoryPanel", "role": "audit log of who changed what and when"},
      {"name": "WeeklySnapshotPreview", "role": "preview of the Friday executive email and manual trigger"},
      {"name": "ExportCsvButton", "role": "downloads the current chart data as CSV"},
      {"name": "RoleGate", "role": "hides admin UI from non-admin users"}
    ]
  },
  "business_logic_contract": {
    "triggers": [
      {"event": "user_first_login", "action": "create users row from OIDC claims; default role='viewer', elevated to 'admin' for finance/sales/ops leads via allowlist"},
      {"event": "dashboard_request", "action": "load all relevant metric_definitions, substitute parameters into sql_template, execute against Snowflake, return values along with definitions_used metadata"},
      {"event": "metric_definition_updated", "action": "insert prior row snapshot into metric_definition_history with changed_by and change_note before applying the update"},
      {"event": "metric_definition_created", "action": "insert initial history row with previous_value=null"},
      {"event": "friday_morning_cron", "action": "node-cron Fridays 08:00 server time: build executive snapshot, render HTML email, send via SMTP to executives, write email_log row"},
      {"event": "csv_export_requested", "action": "re-run the chart's underlying query and stream CSV with filename including chart key and date"}
    ],
    "rules": [
      "all dashboard chart queries MUST resolve metric logic from metric_definitions table — no hardcoded SQL for contested metrics",
      "every dashboard response includes a definitions_used array so the UI can show which definition version powered each number",
      "/metric-definitions write endpoints (POST/PUT) require role in ('admin') — covers finance_leads, sales_leads, operations_leads, admins mapped to admin role",
      "GET dashboard and definition-read endpoints available to any authenticated user",
      "/admin/* endpoints require role='admin'",
      "metric_definition writes are transactional: history insert + update commit together or neither",
      "Snowflake credentials are never exposed to the frontend; all queries proxied through backend"
    ],
    "side_effects": [
      "audit log on every metric_definition create/update via metric_definition_history",
      "email_log row written on every weekly snapshot send attempt (success or failure)"
    ]
  },
  "mga_assistants": []
}
